set.body: Purpose: turn the validated library into an app-ready large-study platform without speculative rewrites. Scope: evidence-approved storage and streaming changes; versioned interchange and reproducible recipes; live analysis and plugin seams; uncertainty-aware measures, dynamic-video integration, and benchmark dashboards behind explicit go/no-go decisions. Exit criteria: all child work is closed; every optimization has an equivalent-work profile; serialization is versioned and canonical; app boundaries preserve identity, provenance, warnings, and cancellation; experimental capabilities are labelled rather than implied stable.
set.title: Phase 3: evidence-gated platform differentiators
